mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_routes ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM user_routes WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_routes ( user_id, name, description, days, distance, budget, daily, attractions, hotels, start_date, end_date, people, transport, status, cover, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{days}, #{distance}, #{budget}, #{daily}, #{attractions}, #{hotels}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{people}, #{transport}, COALESCE(#{status}, 1), #{cover}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_routes SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, days = #{days}, distance = #{distance}, budget = #{budget}, daily = #{daily}, attractions = #{attractions}, hotels = #{hotels}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, people = #{people}, transport = #{transport}, status = #{status}, cover = #{cover}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
